newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia wool indicator drops 14 cents to 739c/kg.
newsitem.headline: Australia wool indicator drops 14 cents to 739c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator dropped 14 cents to 739 cents a kg clean on Tuesday at sales in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International said.
Merino fleece lost ground, with 19 micron down 0.5 percent, 20m down one percent, 21m down two percent, 22/23/26m down 2.5 percent, 24m down four percent and 25m down 3.5 percent.
Merino skirtings of 19/20m were generally unchanged with 21/22m up to one percent cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27m was one percent cheaper, 28/29/30m two percent cheaper and 31m unchanged.
In cardings, lambs were unchanged with locks and crutchings one percent dearer.
WI said trading saw good general competition.
Of the 25,179 bales offered, 6.5 percent were passed in.
Sales continue on Wednesday in Sydney and Melbourne with about 24,100 bales to be offered.
